headline: Iron Ore Futures Fall 1.8% as Chinese Steelmakers Delay Restocking
summary: Dalian iron ore futures fell 1.83% as China's steelmakers held back on restocking. Vale's New York-listed shares remained 35.7% below their April high.
why: China is the world's largest consumer of iron ore, and its steel mills' buying patterns dictate global pricing for the steelmaking ingredient.

impacts.name: Vale
impacts.why: Vale shares trade significantly below prior highs as Chinese demand slows.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Reduced buying activity by Chinese steel mills created downward pressure on Dalian futures.
